question.text: The change in the gravitational potential energy when a body of mass $m$ is raised to a height $n \mathrm{R}$ above the surface of the Earth is (here $R$ is the radius of the Earth)

solution.text: Hints: $\Delta \mathrm{U}=\frac{m g h}{1+\frac{h}{\mathrm{R}}}=\frac{m g \times n \mathrm{R}}{1+\frac{n \mathrm{R}}{\mathrm{R}}}=\frac{n m g \mathrm{R}}{n+1}$
